PostgreSQL target identity, statistics resets and gaps are checked separately. Input times use your computer’s local time.
changes.periodError: Baseline must begin before it ends; Incident must start after Baseline. Periods must not overlap.
changes.invalidPeriods: Select two non-overlapping periods with valid time bounds.
changes.connectionRequired: Choose a connection with diagnostic history.
changes.markerRequired: Enter an event time and title.
changes.sourceBoundary: Incident boundary; actual change time unknown
changes.sourceObservation: Observed/latest sample time; not the exact change time
changes.markersHintActual: Manual events help correlate facts; they do not prove causation.
changes.noSessions: There are not yet two separate series of snapshots for a single PostgreSQL target. Check the dates in History or set up regular collection.
changes.fullListHint: Unchanged rows and fields (including 0 → 0) are hidden by default. Numbers, event causes and saved evidence are not altered. Click a column header to sort; click again to reverse.
changes.noSimilarSql: No changes among comparable SQL statements. Show the full list to inspect the sample.
changes.settingsHintFull: Source, reset_val and pending_restart may differ without a setting value change. These are snapshot metadata, not proof that server configuration changed.
changes.autovacuumHint: Zero workload and maintenance changes are hidden in compact mode. A dash means no difference is shown for this group; it does not mean zero or missing data.
changes.autovacuumNoDiff: No changes were found in the displayed counters. Disable the filter for full table context.
changes.xidHintFull: A small increase in XID age is normal and does not imply a freeze issue. Sort by Δ Age to find the largest changes.
changes.storageNoDiff: No differences among available metrics. Change the filter to see the original values.
changes.indexStatsReset: Statistics continuity is unconfirmed or was reset: scan deltas are not calculated.
changes.indexNoUsage: No confirmed idx_scan growth in the comparable sample. This does not mean the indexes are unused.
changes.indexHealthHint: Only classification changes, suspicious signals or sample composition differences appear here. idx_scan changes without diagnostic signals are shown above.
changes.emptyResult: Choose two periods and click Compare. If there is no data, check the diagnostic collection schedule.
changes.valueLabel: Values: Baseline / Incident. Some metrics may have shorter intervals due to unavailable or reset counters.
changes.name: Title

Timestamp precision varies: manual is the reported time, Settings is detection time, and other sources use observation time or the incident boundary.

historyDetails.AutovacuumResets: Resets and incomplete samples are flagged
historyDetails.AutovacuumNotBloat: Not physical bloat; value at interval end
historyDetails.AutovacuumTrendHint: DML rates are calculated by Rust from monotonic counters for comparable tables.
historyDetails.IndexHealthHeading: Index Health History — index usage and growth
historyDetails.IndexHealthDescription: Saved SQLite snapshots only. Current diagnostics, possible duplicate signals and index details are available in Index Health Analyzer.
historyDetails.IndexHealthEmpty: No Index Health snapshots saved for this connection. Run diagnostics or configure snapshot scheduling.
historyDetails.IndexHealthTrendHint: Counts and classifications from saved measurements. Values are not interpolated across gaps or target changes.
historyDetails.IndexHealthPartial: One snapshot contains only part of the indexes. The results below refer to the comparable sample, not the entire database.
historyDetails.IndexHealthGap: Large gap: values for this interval do not imply steady workload. Per-hour rates are not calculated.
historyDetails.IndexHealthReset: Statistics were reset or reset status is unknown. Usage/DML counter differences are not treated as observed activity.
historyDetails.IndexHealthUnavailable: Automatic comparison is unavailable for this pair. Choose two consecutive measurements of the same PostgreSQL target with valid timestamps.

historyDetails.IoWalHeading: I/O & WAL History — workload and sizes over time
historyDetails.IoWalDescription: Saved SQLite snapshots only. Current PostgreSQL counters and settings are in I/O & WAL Analyzer.
historyDetails.IoWalScope: WAL and checkpoints refer to the entire PostgreSQL instance. Temp files and block hits/reads cover only the selected database. Rates are deltas of cumulative counters; sizes are values at collection time.

historyDetails.IoWalTrendHint: Each statistics group is checked independently. Resets, missing values and unknown reset status are not replaced with zero.
historyDetails.IoWalNoPoints: No comparable interval data for this metric. Try database size or later snapshots.
historyDetails.IoWalTimeHint: Points use actual timestamps. The line is not drawn across intervals with broken continuity or large gaps.
historyDetails.PgssHeading: PGSS History — SQL workload over time
historyDetails.PgssDescription: Historical counters from local SQLite. Choose an interval and investigate query changes without collecting new data.
historyDetails.PgssUnavailable: No usable intervals. At least two snapshots with matching stats_reset/dealloc and nondecreasing counters are required.
historyDetails.PgssConcurrent: Total SQL time may exceed 60 minutes per hour because queries run concurrently. This is not CPU time. WAL and temp I/O cover only the intersection of limited SQL samples.
historyDetails.PgssNoIntervals: No intervals for the selected metric.
historyDetails.PgssTimeline: The X-axis uses actual time. Lines break at PGSS resets, dealloc events and large observation gaps.
historyDetails.PgssRanking: SQL ranking is based on the selected interval. Regression can be checked when a preceding safe interval exists.
historyDetails.PgssNoPrevious: No immediately preceding confirmed interval. You can inspect workload, but changes in latency or SQL contribution remain unproven.
historyDetails.PgssRankingHint: Only saved and comparable queryids are listed. Absence from this list does not mean the query is absent from PostgreSQL.
historyDetails.PgssNoMatches: No matching queryids with usable comparison metrics in the two selected intervals.
historyDetails.PgssNoQueries: No SQL matches the current sort and search. Regressions require two adjacent safe intervals and a shared queryid.

historyDetails.SettingsDescription: Explore saved states, parameter sources and changes between them. Current state is in Configuration Drift.

historyDetails.SettingsTimeHint: The date on the right is the detection time, not necessarily when a change occurred. Gaps and restarts are highlighted separately.

historyDetails.SettingsNoDifferences: No differences found in this snapshot pair. Changes made and reverted between measurements remain possible.
historyDetails.SettingsNoFilterMatch: No changes match the selected filter.
historyDetails.SettingsParameterHint: Only intervals with detected parameter changes are shown. Missing records do not prove there were no changes between snapshots.
historyDetails.XidDescription: This view explores saved measurements. Current blockers, VACUUM and policy selection are in XID Analyzer.
historyDetails.XidEmpty: Save an XID snapshot to view freeze history and table state.
historyDetails.XidNotWraparound: This is not the remaining margin to wraparound
historyDetails.XidTrendHint: X shows actual time, Y shows age. Only consecutive conditionally comparable observations are connected.
historyDetails.XidNotEnough: At least two snapshots with this metric are needed for the chart.
historyDetails.XidZoomHint: The zoomed scale does not start at zero. It reveals small changes but visually amplifies them.

historyDetails.XidGapsHint: Decreasing age suggests horizon advancement but does not prove a specific VACUUM. Restarts, recovery and large gaps are flagged separately.

coverage.question: Is there enough data to compare?
coverage.source: What Changed uses snapshots saved in local SQLite; clicking Compare does not collect PostgreSQL metrics.

tsFinish.guideImpact: Compare saved snapshots from the same connection before and after an Intervention. pgXray executes no SQL during comparison; it compares interval metrics from SQLite and stores the result in the Case.
tsFinish.guideComparisons: This section stores comparisons of Evidence, SQL, EXPLAIN, and results. It keeps verifiable investigation material in a Case rather than automatically determining root cause.
tsFinish.guideSimilar: Fingerprint finds matching signals across saved investigations. Scores help rank similar Cases but do not establish a common root cause.
tsFinish.privacyReset: Mapping cleared. Deanonymization of older files may no longer be possible.
tsFinish.indexMayUnused: Possibly unused — not a DROP recommendation
tsFinish.indexPossibleDuplicate: Possible structural duplicate — not a DROP recommendation
tsFinish.impactFewSnapshots: One of the periods has fewer than two PGSS snapshots. Interval deltas require at least two snapshots in each period.
tsFinish.impactNoConfirmed: No confirmed directional changes in the five per-call metrics were found across comparable intervals. A change in call count alone does not prove improvement or regression.
tsFinish.avHotInvestigate: Below the pgXray heuristic reference (5%). Check whether indexed columns change and whether heap pages have enough room; this is not a diagnosis.
tsFinish.avUnknownReset: PostgreSQL did not report the last statistics reset time (stats_reset = NULL). This does not mean statistics collection is disabled. Individual observations remain available, but cumulative counter continuity is unconfirmed; Advisor will not produce confirmed recommendations.
tsFinish.appSessionUnavailable: Unexpected server response: session data unavailable
tsFinish.appAuthUnavailable: Unexpected server response: authentication state unavailable
tsFinish.appTauriRequired: Run the application through Tauri, not in an ordinary browser.
tsFinish.themeDbaDesc: Graphite background with a teal accent
tsFinish.themeDarkDesc: Neutral dark background with a blue accent
tsFinish.themeStorage: Theme storage unavailable: your selection might not persist after restart.
tsFinish.rankMeanHelp: Latency per call; consider call count
tsFinish.rankTempHelp: Temporary blocks; not proof of insufficient work_mem
tsFinish.rankSharedHelp: Blocks read from shared buffers, not physical IOPS
tsFinish.rankVarianceHelp: Execution variability measured by stddev, not p95

tsFinish.evidenceHistoricalPgss: Historical evidence: PGSS snapshot #{id}. History opens filtered by queryid; manually verify the exact snapshot and userid/dbid/toplevel.
tsFinish.evidenceRelationOid: Current diagnostics opened for relation OID {oid}. Old evidence remains in the Case; OIDs may be reused after object recreation.
tsFinish.evidenceLocksPid: Current Locks / Waits opened. PID {pid} belongs to historical evidence and may have been reused; this does not confirm a live lock.
tsFinish.avHistoryUnconfirmed: History contains {saved} observations, but Advisor can use only {usable}. PostgreSQL did not report stats_reset: collecting more snapshots alone cannot confirm counter continuity. Individual observations remain visible, but rates and policy changes are not justified.
tsFinish.avNeedThree: At least three snapshots are required (currently {count}). Collect more observations later; do not change settings based on a single snapshot.
tsFinish.avEvidenceWarning: {saved} observations saved, but only {usable} are comparable for calculations. With stats_reset = NULL, recollecting alone cannot confirm continuity. Observable changes remain available in History but cannot justify policy candidates.
tsFinish.avResetLabel: Current reset marker: {time}. It must match across all compared snapshots.
tsFinish.avSeriesCount: Saved: {saved}. Latest comparable series: {usable}. Older noncomparable points remain on the charts.
